name: young_man_peace_sign
positive: A flat vector illustration of a young man with dark wavy hair and a short goatee. He is looking at the camera with a playful expression and has his hand in front of his face making a clear 'peace' or 'V' sign, looking through the gap between his fingers. The hand is simple and clean with five distinct well-proportioned fingers, two fingers raised straight in a clear V shape, hand anatomy correct, no extra fingers. He is wearing a light cream or beige shirt with an open collar. The art style is minimalist, clean, with flat color blocks and simple black outlines. Pure white background. Minimalist character design, 1x1
